title: Symbolic valuation agrees with table answers
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-tape machine, let $\mathrm{Ans}$ be a Boolean table of selector answers, and choose natural numbers $W,n,t,a,j$ and a Boolean $b$. For every tape selector $\tau$, Boolean sign $s$, time offset label $T$, and coordinate label $A$, evaluating the symbolic-answer atom under the numerical valuation determined by these parameters gives the same optional Boolean value as the table query selected by $\tau,s$ at the time coordinate represented by $T$ and the position coordinate represented by $A$.
hypotheses_covered: A time-coordinate label T and position-coordinate label A
